title: none of my cats played with the toys.  One DID play with the shipping box.
text: Let cats open the box after removing the tape.  I played with the toys with them by undoing them from the cardboard attachment.  Then, nothing.  I left it scattered around the room and tried to initiate activity among them.  Later, nothing had moved.  My 5 are oldish cats and pretty lazy.  Maybe that is why.  I have canceled future shipment.  THis was my 2nd try at ordering the KitNipBox and I won't try it again.
label: negative
